title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
paper_type_zh: 智能体环境语言世界模型报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计智能体轨迹、世界模型训练、LLM 裁判奖励和评测数据边界的读者
one_line: Qwen-AgentWorld reports CPT, SFT, and GSPO RL over more than 10M seven-domain environment trajectories, releases 35B weights and the separate 2,170-sample AgentWorldBench test set, and leaves the training corpus and reward stack only partially auditable.
Qwen-AgentWorld 报告在七类环境的 1,000 多万条轨迹上依次进行 CPT、SFT 和 GSPO RL，并使用 rubric 加规则的混合奖励；其发布了 35B 权重和独立的 AgentWorldBench 评测集，但训练数据、奖励与环境复现仍不完整。
why: It exposes enough of a frontier agent-world-model pipeline to distinguish trajectory sources, next-state targets, SFT curation, and RL feedback, while showing why an open benchmark and checkpoint do not make the underlying training data reproducible.
inclusion_reason: A frontier model report with unusually concrete disclosure of the next-state data object, trajectory filtering, CPT/SFT/GSPO stages, and hybrid judge/rule feedback, while the training records and core audit artifacts remain unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Agent-facing language world models require more than a paper-level claim that trajectories and reinforcement learning exist. An auditable record must distinguish the interaction source, the serialized state-action-observation object, the target chosen from each trajectory, the filtering and selection rules, the feedback contract, and the released artifacts. Qwen-AgentWorld is useful for this audit because the report exposes many of those stage-level mechanics while withholding the underlying training records.

The central boundary is between training and evaluation. The report says Qwen-AgentWorld is trained on more than 10M environment-interaction trajectories across seven domains. AgentWorldBench, by contrast, is a separately constructed and released test set of 2,170 turn-level samples, each paired with a real-environment observation. The benchmark, released 35B weights, and evaluation code are evidence that evaluation and inference artifacts exist; they are not evidence that the more-than-10M training trajectories, SFT reasoning traces, RL pool, judge, or verifier layer were released.

面向智能体的语言世界模型，不能只凭论文中出现“轨迹”和“强化学习”便视为可审计。可审计记录至少要区分交互来源、序列化的状态—动作—观测对象、从每条轨迹中选择的训练目标、过滤与筛选规则、反馈合同，以及真正公开的产物。Qwen-AgentWorld 的价值正在于：报告披露了较多阶段级机制，却没有公开支撑这些机制的训练记录。

核心边界是训练与评测不能混为一谈。报告称 Qwen-AgentWorld 在横跨七个领域的 1,000 多万条环境交互轨迹上训练；AgentWorldBench 则是另行构建并公开的测试集，共 2,170 个 turn 级样本，每个样本都配有真实环境观测。公开的基准、35B 权重和评测代码能够证明推理与评测产物存在，却不能证明 1,000 多万条训练轨迹、SFT 推理轨迹、RL 数据池、裁判或验证器层已经开放。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Qwen-AgentWorld treats environment simulation as conditional next-observation generation. A system-level instruction specifies the task, action space, optional initial state, demonstrations, and optional simulation instruction. The context then alternates agent actions in user turns with environment observations in assistant turns; given the history and current action, the model predicts one next observation. The unified text schema covers MCP, Search, Terminal, SWE, Android, Web, and OS. Android, Web, and OS states are represented by accessibility trees or UI view hierarchies rather than screenshots.

Training follows “CPT injects, SFT activates, RL sharpens.” CPT learns state-transition dynamics and specialized world knowledge, SFT adds explicit next-state reasoning traces, and GSPO RL optimizes simulation fidelity. SFT draws three candidates per query from an unnamed general-purpose reasoning model and uses an independent judge for best-of-three rejection sampling. RL combines a five-dimension LLM-judge rubric—Format, Factuality, Consistency, Realism, and Quality—with a binary executable verifier on a subset, weighted 9:1 in favor of the rubric.

This mixed feedback contract is partly executable but mostly judge-based. It supports classification as SFT, agent training, and partially verifiable RL; it does not support a claim that the training corpus, judge, verifier, or replayable environments are open.

Qwen-AgentWorld 把环境模拟定义为条件式的下一观测生成。系统提示由任务描述、动作空间、可选初始状态、示例和可选模拟指令五部分组成；上下文随后以 user turn 承载智能体动作、以 assistant turn 承载环境观测，两者交替出现。模型根据历史与当前动作预测一个下一观测。统一文本格式覆盖 MCP、Search、Terminal、SWE、Android、Web 和 OS；其中 Android、Web 与 OS 使用可访问性树或 UI view hierarchy 表示状态，而不是使用截图。

训练遵循“CPT injects, SFT activates, RL sharpens”。CPT 学习状态转移动态和专业领域知识，SFT 加入显式的下一状态推理轨迹，GSPO RL 则优化模拟保真度。SFT 由未具名的通用推理模型为每个查询生成三个候选，并由独立裁判完成 best-of-three 拒绝采样。RL 将五维 LLM 裁判 rubric——Format、Factuality、Consistency、Realism、Quality——与仅覆盖部分样本的二元可执行验证器结合，rubric 与规则奖励权重为 9:1。

因此，反馈合同是“部分可执行、主要依赖裁判”的混合类型。它足以支持 SFT、智能体训练和部分可验证 RL 的分类，但不能据此声称训练语料、裁判、验证器或可回放环境已经开放。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper names three trajectory channels. Dedicated infrastructure runs synthesized tasks against container, MCP, terminal, Android, browser, and desktop backends. Open interaction traces contribute terminal recordings, agent tool-call logs, and repository execution traces after a multi-agent cleaning pipeline. In-house foundation-model SFT trajectories supply a third channel. CPT also adds specialized corpora spanning industrial control, cybersecurity, law, medicine, finance, current affairs, and encyclopedic knowledge. The paper says CPT, SFT, and RL pools are strictly disjoint, but no membership manifests are released.

All records are normalized to the same action-observation schema. Filters drop trajectories with fewer than two turns, MCP/SWE calls to undeclared tools, broken GUI states, empty actions, retry cycles, and GUI turns with no state change. CPT further masks low-information observation tokens using overlap, novelty, Jaccard, and length-ratio statistics while retaining masked turns as context. One random target turn is sampled from each training trajectory.

For SFT, one of ten AutoResearch-produced prompt templates (v2-v11) is sampled, inputs above 256K tokens are truncated, and an unnamed reasoning model generates three candidates. An independent judge selects the best candidate and discards it if it misses an undisclosed threshold; 7,094 of 10,250 candidate queries remain. For RL, the reported train pool contains 92,308 trajectories. Each contributes exactly one target turn, histories above 128K tokens are filtered, and GSPO receives asynchronous rubric scores plus binary rule rewards where available. The report does not disclose decoding settings, RL rollout count, judge identity, score calibration, rule-verifier coverage, optimization hyperparameters, or the training records themselves.

论文列出三条轨迹渠道。专用基础设施让合成任务在容器、MCP、终端、Android、浏览器和桌面后端中执行；公开交互轨迹包括终端录制、智能体工具调用日志和代码仓库执行轨迹，并经过多智能体清洗流水线；内部基础模型的 SFT 智能体轨迹构成第三条渠道。CPT 还加入工业控制、网络安全、法律、医疗、金融、时事和百科知识等专业语料。论文称 CPT、SFT 与 RL 数据池严格互斥，但没有发布成员清单。

所有记录都被规范化为同一动作—观测格式。过滤会删除少于两个 turn 的轨迹、调用未声明工具的 MCP/SWE 轨迹、故障 GUI 状态、空动作、重试循环，以及 GUI 状态不变的 turn。CPT 还依据词元重叠度、新颖度、Jaccard 和长度比，对低信息观测词元进行 loss masking，同时把被 mask 的 turn 保留为后续上下文。训练时，每条轨迹随机选择一个目标 turn。

SFT 从 AutoResearch 生成的十个模板 v2-v11 中抽取一个，截断超过 256K token 的输入，再由未具名推理模型生成三个候选。独立裁判选出最佳候选，若未达到未公开阈值则丢弃；10,250 个候选查询最终保留 7,094 条。报告中的 RL 训练池含 92,308 条轨迹，每条只贡献一个目标 turn，并过滤历史超过 128K token 的记录；GSPO 接收异步 rubric 分数，以及在可用处接收二元规则奖励。解码设置、RL rollout 数、裁判身份、分数校准、规则验证覆盖率、优化超参数和训练记录本身均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official arXiv paper and its HTML version establish the next-observation data object, seven environments, more-than-10M aggregate trajectory claim, three trajectory channels, CPT/SFT/GSPO sequence, filters, SFT rejection sampling, and hybrid RL reward. The paper reports 7,094 retained SFT trajectories, a 92,308-trajectory RL train pool, a 9:1 rubric-to-rule reward mix, and observed self-praise reward hacking with three mitigations.

The official Qwen-AgentWorld repository describes its open-source release as the 35B model weights and AgentWorldBench. The official 35B model card identifies Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base as the base and states that no outputs from external API services were included in the training pipeline. The official AgentWorldBench dataset exposes one test split with about 2.17K rows and fields including task, id, prompt, response, current_prompt, system_str, turn_idx, and total_turns. The Qwen release page likewise presents it as an evaluation benchmark paired with real observations.

These official artifacts do not release the more-than-10M training trajectories, SFT candidates, RL pool, judge identity or weights, complete executable-verifier mapping, or a 397B checkpoint. Reported benchmark scores therefore evidence model behavior under the stated protocol, not training-data quality or reproducibility.

官方 arXiv 论文及其 HTML 版本确认了下一观测数据对象、七类环境、1,000 多万条轨迹总量、三条轨迹渠道、CPT/SFT/GSPO 顺序、过滤规则、SFT 拒绝采样和混合 RL 奖励。论文还报告：SFT 保留 7,094 条轨迹，RL 训练池含 92,308 条轨迹，rubric 与规则奖励按 9:1 混合；作者观察到“自我吹捧”式奖励黑客，并给出三项缓解措施。

官方 Qwen-AgentWorld 仓库把开放产物明确写为 35B 模型权重和 AgentWorldBench。官方 35B 模型卡确认基础模型为 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base，并声明训练流水线未纳入外部 API 服务输出。官方 AgentWorldBench 数据集公开一个约 2.17K 行的 test split，字段包括 task、id、prompt、response、current_prompt、system_str、turn_idx 和 total_turns。Qwen 发布页同样把它定义为配有真实观测的评测基准。

这些官方产物没有发布 1,000 多万条训练轨迹、SFT 候选、RL 数据池、裁判身份或权重、完整的可执行验证器映射，也没有发布 397B 检查点。因此，基准分数只说明模型在所述协议下的行为，不能证明训练数据质量或训练流水线可复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report makes the world-model training object unusually explicit for a frontier release: a five-part system-level instruction, alternating action-observation history, and a single next-observation target. It also connects specific data operations to stages: statistical loss masking in CPT, ten-template diversification and best-of-three rejection sampling in SFT, and one-turn-per-trajectory GSPO with rubric-plus-rule feedback in RL. The disclosed self-praise failure mode further shows how the reward interface can alter generated observations without improving environmental fidelity.

For the frontier-report data-disclosure ledger, the most important contribution is not a benchmark leaderboard. It is the ability to separate four layers that are often collapsed: the claimed more-than-10M training corpus, the smaller disclosed SFT and RL stage pools, the released 35B checkpoint, and the independent 2,170-sample AgentWorldBench test set. AgentWorldBench contains real-observation references and turn-level trajectory fields for evaluation, but it is neither a manifest nor a released subset of the training corpus.

相较一般前沿模型发布，论文对世界模型训练对象的定义较为具体：五部分系统提示、动作与观测交替组成的历史，以及单个下一观测目标。它还把数据操作与训练阶段逐一对应：CPT 使用统计式 loss masking，SFT 使用十模板多样化和 best-of-three 拒绝采样，RL 则采用“每轨迹一个 turn”的 GSPO 与 rubric 加规则的混合反馈。论文披露的“自我吹捧”失败模式，也说明奖励接口可能改变生成观测，却不一定改善环境保真度。

对于前沿报告数据披露账本，最重要的贡献不是排行榜结果，而是能够分开审计四层对象：声称存在但未发布的 1,000 多万条训练语料、规模较小且仅披露统计量的 SFT/RL 阶段池、已发布的 35B 检查点，以及独立的 2,170 样本 AgentWorldBench 测试集。AgentWorldBench 为评测提供真实观测参考和 turn 级轨迹字段，但它既不是训练语料清单，也不是已发布的训练子集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The training-data disclosure stops at aggregate scale and source classes. There is no trajectory inventory, per-source count, mixture weight, collection date, task-query manifest, source license ledger, item-level lineage, or released CPT/SFT/RL record. The model-card statement excluding external API-service outputs narrows one acquisition path but does not identify the generators or rights attached to each record. The claims that stage pools are disjoint and AgentWorldBench is out of distribution are not accompanied by public membership lists or a complete contamination audit.

The feedback layer is also incomplete. The SFT generator and independent judge are unnamed, and their versions, prompts, sampling settings, threshold, and error behavior are unknown. RL uses an LLM judge for most of the stated reward mass; its identity, calibration, and aggregation behavior are not released. Executable rules cover only a subset, without a coverage table or complete verifier code. Although the paper reports self-praise reward hacking and mitigates it with rule anchoring, content-type classification, and strict tag extraction, no independent robustness audit is available.

Only Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B is released in the checked official artifacts; the 397B checkpoint and its starting lineage remain unavailable. Apache-2.0 covers the official repository, released weights, and AgentWorldBench, not necessarily the underlying training traces or upstream corpora. None of the reported performance results proves that those unreleased records are accurate, representative, uncontaminated, or legally reusable.

训练数据披露停留在总规模和来源类别。官方材料没有给出轨迹清单、各来源计数、混合权重、采集日期、任务查询清单、来源许可账本、样本级谱系，也没有公开 CPT/SFT/RL 记录。模型卡中“未使用外部 API 服务输出”的声明只排除了一条采集路径，仍不能确认每条记录的生成者和权利。阶段池互斥与 AgentWorldBench 分布外的说法，也没有公开成员表或完整污染审计支撑。

反馈层同样不完整。SFT 生成器和独立裁判均未具名，其版本、提示、采样设置、阈值和误差行为都是 unknown。RL 的大部分奖励权重来自 LLM 裁判，但裁判身份、校准与聚合行为没有发布。可执行规则只覆盖一个子集，且没有覆盖表或完整验证器代码。论文虽然报告了“自我吹捧”式奖励黑客，并以规则锚定、内容类型分类和严格标签提取缓解，但尚无独立稳健性审计。

已核查的官方产物仅开放 Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B；397B 检查点及其起始谱系仍不可得。Apache-2.0 适用于官方仓库、已发布权重和 AgentWorldBench，不必然覆盖底层训练轨迹与上游语料。论文中的性能结果也不能证明这些未发布记录准确、有代表性、无污染或可合法复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the frontier reports and data-disclosure ledger track, this Card is a comparison instrument for agent-environment pipelines. It lets curators ask the same questions across reports: What is one data record? Which actor produced the action trace? Which environment produced the observation? How is a target turn selected? Which filters alter the record? Is feedback executable, judge-based, or mixed? Can the released artifacts replay training, or only evaluate a checkpoint?

Qwen-AgentWorld supports a precise classification. The report describes SFT reasoning-trace curation and GSPO RL over environment trajectories, with a mixed reward that is mostly LLM-judge rubric feedback and partly executable verification. It also releases a useful evaluation set with real-observation references. It does not justify labels such as open training trajectories, fully reproducible RLVR, released judge, complete verifier coverage, or replayable training environment.

The training-versus-evaluation distinction is reusable beyond this paper: a benchmark can expose rich trajectory-shaped rows while remaining an evaluation artifact. Curators should count AgentWorldBench’s 2,170 rows as released test data and keep the more-than-10M training corpus at unknown availability until a separate official release is verified.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，这张 Card 可作为比较智能体—环境流水线的审计工具。它促使策展者对不同报告提出同一组问题：一个数据记录是什么？谁生成动作轨迹？哪个环境产生观测？目标 turn 如何选择？哪些过滤会改写记录？反馈是可执行、裁判式还是混合式？公开产物足以回放训练，还是只能评测检查点？

Qwen-AgentWorld 可以被精确归类。报告描述了环境轨迹上的 SFT 推理轨迹筛选和 GSPO RL；其混合奖励主要依赖 LLM 裁判 rubric，少部分来自可执行验证。项目还发布了带真实观测参考的评测集。它并不足以支持“训练轨迹开放”“RLVR 完全可复现”“裁判已发布”“验证器覆盖完整”或“训练环境可回放”等标签。

训练与评测的区分也适用于其他论文：即使一个基准公开了结构丰富、形似轨迹的记录，它仍然可能只是评测产物。策展时应把 AgentWorldBench 的 2,170 条记录计为公开测试数据；在单独的官方训练数据发布得到核实前，1,000 多万条训练语料的可得性应保持为 unknown。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Sections 2.2 and 2.3 of the paper HTML to identify the five-part system-level instruction, alternating action-observation schema, and next-observation target.
  • Read Sections 3.1-3.4 together: source collection and filtering precede three distinct pools, SFT retains 7,094 of 10,250 candidate queries, and the RL train pool contains 92,308 trajectories with one target turn each.
  • Inspect the reward-stability discussion, not only the reward formula. The paper reports self-praise reward hacking and uses rule anchoring, content-type classification, and tag extraction as mitigations.
  • Compare the more-than-10M training claim with the separate 2,170-row AgentWorldBench release. The former is unreleased training data; the latter is a released test split with real-observation references.
  • Treat the official repository and 35B model card as evidence for released weights, prompts, and evaluation tooling—not for release of the training corpus, RL judge, verifier coverage, or 397B checkpoint.

• 先读论文 HTML 的 2.2 与 2.3 节，确认五部分系统提示、动作—观测交替格式和下一观测目标。
  • 把 3.1 至 3.4 节连起来读：来源采集与过滤发生在三个独立阶段池之前；SFT 从 10,250 个候选查询保留 7,094 条，RL 训练池含 92,308 条轨迹且每条只选一个目标 turn。
  • 不要只看奖励公式，还要读训练稳定性讨论。论文报告了“自我吹捧”式奖励黑客，并以规则锚定、内容类型分类和标签提取作为缓解措施。
  • 对照 1,000 多万条训练轨迹的声称与独立的 2,170 行 AgentWorldBench 发布：前者是未发布训练数据，后者是含真实观测参考的已发布 test split。
  • 把官方仓库和 35B 模型卡视为权重、提示和评测工具已发布的证据，不要把它们当作训练语料、RL 裁判、验证器覆盖表或 397B 检查点已发布的证据。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Yuxin Zuo, Zikai Xiao, Li Sheng, et al. Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents. arXiv:2606.24597, 2026. Official arXiv record. Official project page.

The author list follows the official arXiv record and paper author section. No separate venue publication was verified; cite the work as an arXiv preprint unless a later official record is confirmed.

Yuxin Zuo, Zikai Xiao, Li Sheng, et al. Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents. arXiv:2606.24597, 2026。官方 arXiv 记录。官方项目页。

作者信息依据官方 arXiv 记录和论文作者章节。尚未核实到独立的正式会议或期刊出版记录；除非后续出现经确认的官方记录，否则应按 arXiv preprint 引用。

value.html: Training uses more than 10M environment-interaction trajectories from dedicated agent infrastructure, open interaction traces, and in-house agentic SFT trajectories; CPT additionally uses specialized-domain world-knowledge corpora. The released AgentWorldBench is a separate 2,170-sample test set, not the reported training corpus.

A sample contains a system-level instruction, prior alternating user turns carrying agent actions and assistant turns carrying environment observations, the current action, and one next-observation target. The released AgentWorldBench test rows expose task, id, prompt, response, current_prompt, system_str, turn_idx, and total_turns.

Dedicated-infrastructure agent systems and in-house foundation-model agents produce two training sources; authors of open traces vary and item-level attribution is undisclosed. An unnamed general-purpose reasoning model generates SFT candidates. AgentWorldBench uses frontier-agent trajectories: the report names Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.6 for text-domain collection and says three Qwen-family models augment GUI collection, without naming all three.
Seven text-serialized environments: MCP, Search, Terminal, SWE, Android, Web, and OS. Android, Web, and OS use accessibility trees or UI view hierarchies rather than pixel observations.

LWM RL uses an LLM judge scoring Format, Factuality, Consistency, Realism, and Quality from 1 to 5, plus a binary executable rule verifier for a subset; the two rewards are mixed 9:1 (rubric:rule). AgentWorldBench separately uses reference-grounded judging against released real-environment observations and targeted rule checks.

The training objective is next-environment-observation fidelity; a subset has executable 0/1 verification, but its coverage is undisclosed. Benchmark evaluation compares a prediction with its real observation using the five-dimension rubric and selected deterministic checks.

The released Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B checkpoint is based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base. The report also studies Qwen-AgentWorld-397B-A17B, but the checked official release does not provide its checkpoint or starting lineage.
SFT candidates come from an unnamed general-purpose reasoning model and are scored by an unnamed independent judge; identities, versions, licenses, and calibration are unknown.

Dedicated infrastructure synthesizes domain tasks and lets agent systems execute them end to end; open and in-house trajectories are normalized into the same schema. SFT generates three reasoning rollouts per query.

Training randomly samples one target turn from each trajectory. SFT uniformly samples one of templates v2-v11, truncates samples above 256K tokens, and retains the best of three judged rollouts only above a minimum threshold. RL uses one turn per trajectory and filters histories above 128K tokens.

Trajectory filters remove records with fewer than two turns, undeclared MCP/SWE tools, broken GUI environments, empty actions, retry cycles, and GUI no-change turns. CPT applies information-theoretic loss masking from token-overlap statistics. SFT applies best-of-three judge rejection sampling, but its score threshold is undisclosed.
SFT uses a 256K-token context window; RL history is capped at 128K tokens. Generation limits, decoding parameters, and the RL on-policy rollout count are unknown.

Three stages: continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and GSPO reinforcement learning. The report gives 7,094 SFT trajectories after rejection sampling and a 92,308-trajectory RL train pool; RL invokes the judge asynchronously and combines rubric and rule rewards.

The report states more than 10M trajectories and names three trajectory channels plus specialized CPT corpora, but publishes no item inventory, mixture weights, per-source counts, collection dates, or public-trace license manifest. The official model card states that external API-service outputs were not included in the training pipeline; this does not resolve item-level provenance.

CPT, SFT, and RL pools are stated to be strictly disjoint. AgentWorldBench is a distinct 2,170-row test set built from five frontier agents on nine established benchmark suites. No train-pool manifest, source-level overlap report, or released mapping establishes the claimed separation independently.

AgentWorldBench is described as out of distribution because training and benchmark queries are partitioned at the source level. The checked artifacts do not provide a complete contamination, source-overlap, or memorization audit.

items: The more-than-10M figure describes unreleased training trajectories; AgentWorldBench contains 2,170 evaluation samples and must not be counted as released training data.
The RL reward is weighted mostly toward an LLM-judge rubric (9:1 rubric:rule), while the judge identity, version, calibration, and error analysis are not released.
Executable rule verification covers only a subset; coverage, verifier mapping, and complete verifier code are unavailable.
The report observes self-praise reward hacking and describes rule anchoring, content-type classification, and tag extraction as mitigations, but provides no independent robustness audit.
Claims that the stage pools are disjoint and the benchmark is out of distribution are not backed by public split manifests or a full contamination study.
Benchmark results measure model simulation performance; they do not establish completeness, legality, or quality of the unreleased training trajectories.
